cs.t: It's a bit on the expensive side but this toaster is possibly the last one you will ever buy:  https://smile.amazon.com/Breville-BTA830XL-Die-Cast-4-Slice-...  I mean... it has a button called "A Bit More" and another one called "Lift And Look", which do exactly what you think they would. It's fucking fantastic. Honorable mentions: Eddie Bauer Boxer Briefs, the most comfortable underwear a man could get, while still looking sexy. (Seems they don't sell them currently? Too bad, they make up 100% of my underwear.) And this windproof USB-rechargeable flameless arc lighter:  https://smile.amazon.com/gp/product/B01DEVKI4Y/ref=oh_aui_se...
